tickerText: [TENNIS] Leylah Fernandez upsets No. 5 Mirra Andreeva 6-1, 6-4 in Toronto as Ben Shelton and Joao Fonseca advance in Montreal ahead of Saturday's NBO quarterfinals • [SQUASH] London Squash Classic draws are out — Paul Coll defends as top seed and Hania El Hammamy leads the women's field; Salman Khalil won his maiden World Events title in Karachi • [BADMINTON] Indonesia withdraws two mixed doubles pairs from the BWF World Championships amid a match-fixing probe as New Delhi readies for August 17–23 • [PICKLEBALL] Carvana PPA Tour debuts unified World Pickleball Rankings for 2026–27; Veolia National Championships in Cary opens the global season August 31 • [TABLE TENNIS] Harimoto, Matsushima and Shinozuka lead a Japanese charge into WTT Yokohama quarterfinals as the Lebrun brothers also advance; Sreeja Akula's five-game run ends vs Shin Yubin

newsItems.title: London Classic Draws Set
newsItems.excerpt: Paul Coll returns as defending champion and top seed at the London Squash Classic, while Hania El Hammamy heads the women's field for the season's first Gold event.

newsItems.title: Indonesia Pulls Pairs From Worlds
newsItems.excerpt: PBSI withdrew two mixed doubles pairs from the BWF World Championships in New Delhi amid an ongoing BWF match-fixing investigation.

newsItems.title: PPA Season Opens in Cary
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026–27 Carvana PPA Tour kicks off with the Veolia Pickleball National Championships in Cary, North Carolina, running August 31 to September 6.

newsItems.title: Japan Trio Into Yokohama QFs
newsItems.excerpt: Tomokazu Harimoto, Sora Matsushima and Hiroto Shinozuka all reached the WTT Champions Yokohama quarterfinals as Sreeja Akula fell in five games to Shin Yubin.
